theme_brief: ক্ষুধিত পাষাণ: one Hindustani/Persian court palette (sarangi, santoor, setar, tanpura drone), eerie and longing, no vocals. Eight 240 s beds, one per eighth of film-01's 36 scenes as `film --cues-job` spreads them (scenes 1-4, 5-9, 10-13, 14-18, 19-22, 23-27, 28-31, 32-36; about 155-312 s of narration each by the plan's estimate); looped by eav.mix.arrange_cues where narration runs longer. Ducked 19 dB under speech; silence at turns is the edit's job.
